verdict.rationale: Isaac Lab has versioned major releases (2.x to 3.0) and points users to a "Migrating To 3.0" guide that lists breaking changes, so some first-party version and migration documentation exists. No formal deprecation policy, deprecation windows, or API-versioning guarantees appear in the evidence, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy and timelines, explicit API versioning scheme across Isaac Sim/ROS/GR00T, stability guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Upgrading from Isaac Lab 2.x? See the Migrating To 3.0 guide for a full list of breaking changes and the new multi-backend architecture
